test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All trees are mud.

Some mud are sand.

No sand is a flower.

Conclusions:

(I): No tree is a flower.

(II): Some sand are trees.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfe270bdf2d53bd9d33159007946f7671c65284773affdcf573da1e48544a94b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I): No tree is a flower → False (As, there is no direct relation between tree and flower)

(II): Some sand are trees → Flase (As, there is no direct relation between sand and trees)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
